label: tado X Bridge X Thread border router
description: The tado Bridge X is the Thread border router that puts a tado X heating system (Smart Thermostat X, radiator thermostats, sensors) on the internet and bridges it to Matter controllers. It is WiFi-only: it plugs into a wall socket and joins the home network over 2.4 GHz WiFi via WPS or a WiFi password, with no Ethernet port; the Thread radio that talks to the thermostats is not modelled as an IP interface.
